pr_title: Adds missing touch option to has_one association
pr_body:
fixes #35866

As requested by @dhh, we have added `touch` option to `has_one` association.

issue_context.title: Add missing touch option to has_one
issue_context.body: We have a `touch: true/false` option for belongs_to, but not for has_one. Let's add that. It's often necessary to touch in that direction as well.
comments: @dhh Can I work on this?? I work on this today.

👍🙏

review_comments:
`:touch` option can be given extra touched attribute name (e.g. `has_one :membership, touch: :joined_at`),
That is why `record.send(touch_method, touch)` if `touch != true` in belongs_to association.

https://github.com/rails/rails/blob/bc8697e1f642e40e511e5d5f0b459658d4b2724d/activerecord/lib/active_record/associations/builder/belongs_to.rb#L57-L61
My bad. I have fixed this.
Why `record.send(touch_method, touch)` only when `touch` is falsy?
Thanks, @kamipo . This was not needed. I have removed that and tested in an app.
